comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I think this event is running on GAMA right now:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?LiveEvent/Viking

Cat Ears are listed as a possible reward, though it may not be this pair in question. As to how the event works, not sure... seems to require plundering special event NPC ships.

comments.author: Kossmynn
comments.body: Yes, they drop from the "Superior Box" given by the Lady after offering her 5x Viking Logbooks (drop from Rogues' chest plundered from the fleets).

comments.author: LFranco
comments.body: I heard that +26v/+30h, -1 turn(Improved full rigged) sails also dropping from the "Superior Box", is this true? If so that would be one of the better possible rewards for an event I've heard of in quite a while.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: Lovely! But do I really have to melee/plunder the viking fleets to get the rogues' chest? I would much prefer to burn those would-be vikings with a few AoS instead. Thanks for the answer in advance!

comments.body: Plundering the Rogues' chest work the same as normal plunder? (increased chance with seize cargo and oxford skills)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Thanks Kossmynn. I took the liberty of running the Superior Box rewards' names through JP-side of ivyro. Updated list, excluding cat ears:

Dougusoku
Vigilante
Ecarlate
Chapeau Ecarlate
Wrinkled Eboshi
White Jade Kanzashi
Orange Crown
Bear Doll
Bajougutsu

Interesting selection, though the East Asian items are already obtainable through Helder's Nanban Festival Bag, and the crown does have some court rank restrictions.

I don't know if Superior Box drops have been altered for GAMA, though; hope not, wouldn't mind getting the cat ears, or even the Vigilante clothing. Since the event relies on melee plunder, I would guess Oxford/Aide skills increase your chances; the harder the fleet, the better the odds of getting what you need, also. I figure it can't hurt to have extra plunder boots in place, right? Maybe someone else can comment if they know something.
